name: markdownlint-cli2-action
description: A GitHub Action to run the markdownlint-cli2 tool for linting Markdown/CommonMark files with the markdownlint library

config.description: Path of a file to use for the base configuration object (defaults to none)

fix.description: Whether to fix supported issues automatically (any truthy value enables)

globs.description: Glob expression(s) of files to lint (newline-delimited)

separator.description: String to use as a separator for the "globs" input (defaults to newline)
